technology_name: Maxillofacial Surgery Planning and Simulation Software-(MaxSim)
institution: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
problem_solved: Complexity in planning and evaluating maxillofacial surgical procedures
description: MaxSim is a facial surgery planning and simulation system designed for diagnosis, treatment planning, and evaluation of maxillofacial treatment outcomes. The software assists clinicians in visualizing treatment options and supports informed decision-making during surgical planning.
applications:
Maxillofacial surgery and dental specialty hospitals
Craniofacial reconstruction and plastic surgery centers
Dental colleges, teaching hospitals, and medical universities
Medical imaging and surgical planning software companies
Healthcare institutions adopting digital surgery and treatment planning solutions
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
